free_tier.stated: No free tier: the Cold Archive class is billed from the first GiB at USD 0.0000027 per GiB-hour (about USD 0.001971 per GiB-month), with no capacity cap stated; a 180-day minimum storage duration is billed and data retrieval costs USD 0.01062 per GiB

egress.terms: External ingoing and outgoing traffic free and API requests free; an object is read back only after a restore, billed at USD 0.01062 per GiB retrieved, and the restored copy is billed in the Standard class while it stays accessible

interface_detail: S3-compatible API, reachable only from the Paris 3-AZ region (EU-WEST-PAR)

identity_cost.detail: an email address validated by a one-time code, the country of tax residence, and a valid payment method on the account before the first Public Cloud project; Visa, Mastercard and Maestro cards are accepted, and PayPal and a prepaid account are offered as payment methods

reliability_note: Tape-backed class with a 99.9% availability SLA and eleven nines of durability; a restore takes from a few minutes to several hours up to a terabyte and at most 48 hours for hundreds of terabytes
confidence_note: documented: the international price list, the storage classes page, the Object Storage technical limits page, the account-creation guide and the free-trial page were read and quoted on 2026-10-30; a read timed from a bucket would make it measured

evidence.proved: $2.02/TB/mo — genuinely near the floor — but retrieval is $0.01062/GiB (~$10.87/TB) plus a 180-day minimum storage duration, and restoration takes hours. Fine for the 20 TiB write-once…
Cold Archive is an S3-compatible storage class
evidence.quote: The most cost-effective Amazon S3* compatible class for sustainably storing your rarely accessed data.

evidence.proved: Cold Archive costs USD 0.0000027 per GiB-hour, about USD 0.001971 per GiB-month, with free external traffic and API requests, a USD 0.01062 per GiB retrieval fee and 180 days of minimum storage billed
Cold Archive is reachable only from the Paris region EU-WEST-PAR
evidence.quote: Accessible only from the Paris region (EU-WEST-PAR): your data is securely stored in France, distributed across four dedicated datacentres optimised for this storage class.

evidence.proved: a valid payment method is required on the account before the first Public Cloud project
evidence.quote: You need to add a valid payment method to your OVHcloud customer account before starting the free trial, which will be used after your free trial ends, if you want to keep running the project you have launched.

evidence.proved: OVHcloud accepts Visa, Mastercard and Maestro cards; the same page offers PayPal and a prepaid account
evidence.quote: Cards accepted are Visa, Mastercard, Maestro.

evidence.proved: account creation validates the email address with a one-time code
evidence.quote: After you submit this form, a one-time code will be sent to the email address you entered.

evidence.proved: Cold Archive carries a 99.9% availability SLA and eleven nines of durability
evidence.quote: Cold Archive is built to ISO standards (27001, 27017, 27018, 27701), and data availability is ensured by a 99.9% service level agreement (SLA), with a data durability of eleven nines.

notes: USD 1.84 per TB per month (USD 0.001971 per GiB-month x 931.32 GiB per TB) and USD 9.89 per TB retrieved (USD 0.01062 per GiB); a 180-day minimum storage duration is billed per object

dead_end.why: $2.02/TB/mo — genuinely near the floor — but retrieval is $0.01062/GiB (~$10.87/TB) plus a 180-day minimum storage duration, and restoration takes hours. Fine for the 20 TiB write-once…
